title: [Renseikai] Lesson Attendance – Submit Attendance – Config audience=["parent"] – All status options available for parent
description: Happy Path — When lesson.submit_attendance.audience = ["parent"], the parent can open the response form and all four status options (Attend, Absent, Late, Leave Early) are available. Parent submits successfully.
preconditions:
Config lesson.submit_attendance.audience = ["parent"] is set for the Renseikai tenant
Lesson L6 is Published and upcoming; Parent F is linked to Student F assigned to Lesson L6
Parent F has not submitted an attendance response for Lesson L6
steps_actions:
1. Open Learner App as Parent F and navigate to Lesson L6 detail
2. Tap the Submit Attendance button
3. Observe the list of available status options
4. Select status = Attend and tap Submit
5. Re-open Lesson L6 detail
steps_result:
1. Lesson detail is displayed; Submit Attendance button is visible
2. Attendance response form opens
3. Options shown: Attend, Absent, Late, Leave Early (4 options total)
4. Submission succeeds; success feedback is shown
5. Submitted attendance response is displayed as Attend
steps_data:
1. Lesson L6
2. Parent F
3. —
4. Status: Attend
5. Lesson L6
suite: [Renseikai] Lesson Attendance – Submit Attendance Button Control

title: [Renseikai] Lesson Attendance – Submit Attendance – Config audience=["parent"] – Parent updates previously submitted response
description: State Transition — When lesson.submit_attendance.audience = ["parent"], a parent who already submitted an attendance response can open the form again and change the status.
preconditions:
Config lesson.submit_attendance.audience = ["parent"] is set for the Renseikai tenant
Lesson L7 is Published and not yet started; Parent G is linked to Student G assigned to Lesson L7
Parent G has already submitted attendance status = Absent for Lesson L7
steps_actions:
1. Open Learner App as Parent G and navigate to Lesson L7 detail
2. Tap the Submit Attendance button again
3. Change status to Late and tap Submit
4. Re-open Lesson L7 detail
steps_result:
1. Lesson detail is displayed; existing response shown as Absent
2. Attendance response form opens with Absent pre-selected
3. Submission succeeds; success feedback is shown
4. Attendance response is updated to Late
steps_data:
1. Lesson L7
2. Parent G
3. New status: Late
4. Lesson L7
suite: [Renseikai] Lesson Attendance – Submit Attendance Button Control
